applies_to: Phase 6 end-to-end holdout on real public evidence (evaluation correction, owner verdict 2026-10-10)
freeze_rule: Committed before holdout-e2e construction. The end-to-end holdout must use real public CVE evidence disjoint from both development datasets; the complete TypeScript -> Python -> TypeScript -> scratch-database pipeline runs exactly once against it, including receipt, trace, Story/Fact immutability, stale-version, and idempotency checks. A failed or consumed holdout stays immutable; remediation requires a new disjoint holdout. The earlier synthetic normalization fixture holdout (23 cases) is retained as evidence only and is not a gate.
